pins.text: A Wix ad across the top of every page
The browser tab just said "Home | randygpool"
No contact form, and the phone number wasn't tap-to-call

hofba-before-mobile.alt: The old Wix site on a phone, with the page running off the right edge of the screen

pins.text: On a phone, the page ran off the side of the screen

nate-anatomy-hero.alt: The top of the Nate Hall Insurance homepage, with his photo, name, intro and a Call Now button

pins.text: Who he is, what kind of agent and where, before anything else.
The first paragraph explains what independent means. He works for you, not for one insurance company.
Call Now is the first button, and it dials his number from a phone.
Every line he sells, listed in plain words.

nate-anatomy-footer.alt: The Nate Hall Insurance footer, with licensing states and a carrier disclaimer

pins.text: The states he's licensed in, on every page.
A plain disclaimer: products come through various carriers, not every product is sold in every state, and the site isn't an offer of coverage.

nate-anatomy-form.alt: The Nate Hall Insurance quote request form

pins.text: A note at the top asks people not to send health details or policy numbers.
Checkboxes for the kind of coverage, so nobody types a health history into a comment box.
